name: Investigate the Scourge of Thunder Bluff
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 625 experience instead of 650, 0.96 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The Lich King has sent his undead upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Thunder Bluff from these accursed invaders?

There are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
narrative.objectives: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Thunder Bluff and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hmm. From what you've told me, the voices within the circles... they must be used for communication of some kind. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane.  The Argent Dawn appreciates your service.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you investigated the invasion yet? There's no time for dawdling!
